narrative.headline: Healthcare and Airlines lead conviction flow, while Semicap equipment shows a sharp bull/bear split within the same industry.
bullish_themes: Healthcare dominance across sub-industries — Drug Manufacturers (ABBV, LLY, BMY, GILD), Healthcare Plans (MOH, CI), and Diagnostics (CRL, TMO) all printing ask-side bullish flow
Airlines showing coordinated bid — ALK, DAL fully bullish with AAL leaning bullish on $5.1M premium
Regional and diversified banks quietly accumulating — USB, CFG fully bullish; WFC, JPM, BAC leaning bullish on meaningful size
Industrials bid concentrated in transports and machinery (UNP, PH, URI) rather than heavy equipment
notable_individual_flows: GLW — $24M premium at 94.6% bullish with 43 ask-side prints, the standout conviction trade of the scan
NVDA — $48M premium leaning bullish (63.4%), the largest dollar flow in the book
AMD — $27M premium at 59.7% bullish reinforces the semi demand side
CRL — top score (9.71) with 100% bullish flow on $2.6M premium, cleanest signal in healthcare
COHR — $14M premium at 89.3% bearish, the most aggressive single-name short flow
narrative.absences: Despite XLK qualifying at the Industry Layer, Semiconductor Equipment is internally split — AMKR and LRCX bullish but KLAC, TER, ONTO carrying heavy bearish flow, neutralizing the sub-industry. No bullish flow surfaced in Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (CAT, DE both bearish) or in Specialty Industrial Machinery's mega-caps (GEV, EMR bearish despite PH bullish).
